blocks.text: 82 Surrender to cemetery trust of unexercised right of interment
An unexercised right of interment may be surrendered to the cemetery trust which granted it— t—

items.text: by the sole holder of the unexercised right of interment; or
if the unexercised right of interment is held by more than one person, by all of the holders of that right of interment acting jointly.

blocks.text: On the surrender of a right of interment to a cemetery trust under subsection (1)—

items.text: the cemetery trust must pay to the holder or holders a refund based on the current cemetery trust fee payable for the same type of right of interment less the relevant cemetery trust fee for administration and any maintenance costs; and

Surrender to cemetery trust of exercised right of  interment
(1) An exercised right of interment may be  surrendered to the cemetery trust which granted  it— t—
(a) by the sole holder of the exercised right of  interment; or
(b) if the exercised right of interment is held by  more than one person, by all of the holders  of that right of interment acting jointly.
(2) On the surrender of a right of interment to a  cemetery trust under subsection (1)—
(a) subject to subsection (2A), the cemetery trust  must pay to the holder or holders a refund  based on the current cemetery trust fee  payable for the same type of right of  interment less —
(i) the relevant cemetery trust fee for  administration and any maintenance  costs; and
(ii) the restoration costs, if any; and (b) the person or persons surrendering the right  of interment have no further entitlements or  responsibilities under that right of interment.

blocks.text: Part 6 — Rights of interment in a public cemetery

items.text: No refund is payable to a person or persons surrendering a right of interment to a cemetery trust under subsection (1) if, at the time of the surrender, human remains are interred at the place of interment to which the surrendered right of interment applied.
If a right of interment is surrendered to a cemetery trust under this section, the cemetery trust may—
remove any memorial on the place of interment to which the surrendered right of interment applied; and

if there are no human remains interred in the place of interment to which the surrendered right of interment applied, grant a right of interment in respect of the place of interment to which the surrendered right of interment applied—
for interring human remains in a public grave; or
for interring human remains in that place of interment.

blocks.text: 84 Surrender to cemetery trust of right of interment— more than one holder

items.text: The holder of a right of interment who is not the sole holder of that right of interment may surrender that person's entitlement in the right of interment by notifying the cemetery trust in writing.
On the surrender of an entitlement in a right of interment under subsection (1)—
